gloss: to be connected, to lead to

definitions.gloss: to be connected, to be linked
to lead to, to result in
definitions.explanation: To have a connection that leads somewhere.

notes:
{繋|つな}がる means to be connected or to lead to something.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- Pair: {繋|つな}ぐ (transitive, to connect)

ASPECT (ている):
{繋|つな}がっている indicates a state of being connected: インターネットに{繋|つな}がっている (connected to the internet).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜に{繋|つな}がる: to be connected to ~
- 〜が{繋|つな}がる: ~ gets connected
- 〜に{繋|つな}がる: to lead to ~ (figurative)
- {電話|でんわ}が{繋|つな}がらない: the call won't go through

COMMON USES:
- {電話|でんわ}が{繋|つな}がる: phone connects
- インターネットに{繋|つな}がる: to connect to internet
- {努力|どりょく}が{成功|せいこう}に{繋|つな}がる: effort leads to success
- {命|いのち}を{繋|つな}ぐ: to sustain life (transitive pair)
